play.definition: An aggressive punt-rush play in which one or more receiving-team players attack the punt protection immediately after the snap with the intent to reach the punter and contact the football during the kicking operation. Rushers may attack an edge, interior gap, overload, stunt, or delayed lane, while other players contain a fake, occupy protectors, maintain a return option, or prepare to recover a blocked or deflected ball.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

action.label: Punt Ball
action.definition: A punter's action of dropping the football and striking it with the foot to send it downfield on a punt play.

action.label: Snap Receive
action.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.
